newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower in after-hours trade on Thursday, as expectations of a large number of deliveries at the spot expiry later this month prompted investors to liquidate their longs, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen to 0.8 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark February was 0.6 yen weaker at 141.3 yen.

Given an increase in Japan's rubber stocks, expectations of large deliveries at the expiry were growing, which put downward pressure on nearby months, the traders said. Volume during the day was 8,560 lots.
